title: Pharmacy and doctor
practiceFocus: Role-play describing symptoms and asking for help

points.title: Should, can, must, and what hurts
points.rule: Deber plus an infinitive is a gentle should. Poder plus an infinitive, from day 16, is can. Tener que plus an infinitive, from days 4 and 15, is a stronger must. Doler, from day 18, says what hurts. Combine them to describe a problem and ask for what you need.
points.pattern: deber / poder / tener que + infinitive · me duele + body part

examples.english: I have to go to the doctor.

tips: The second verb always stays in the infinitive: debo descansar, puedo esperar.
Use usted with a pharmacist or a doctor: ¿puede ayudarme?, ¿tiene algo para…?
Llame a una ambulancia is an usted command, from day 26.

mistakes.why: After deber, the next verb is the infinitive.
Use doler with me, and la for the body part.

check.prompt: I should rest for a few days.

grammar.notYet: The full range of emergency vocabulary. These phrases cover a minor illness and a request for help.

phrases.spanish: ¿Tiene algo para el dolor de cabeza?
phrases.english: Do you have something for a headache?
I should rest for a few days.

phrases.spanish: Llame a una ambulancia, por favor.
phrases.note: Formal command, urgent. Say it whole.

phrases.spanish: Tengo que tomar esta medicina dos veces al día.
phrases.english: I have to take this medicine twice a day.

lines.speaker: Farmacéutica
lines.english: Good morning, what do you need?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Me duele la garganta y tengo fiebre.
lines.english: My throat hurts and I have a fever.

lines.speaker: Farmacéutica
lines.english: Since when have you been feeling this way?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Desde ayer. También me duele la cabeza.
lines.english: Since yesterday. My head hurts too.

lines.speaker: Farmacéutica
lines.spanish: Tome esto dos veces al día y debe descansar. Si no mejora, tiene que ir al médico.
lines.english: Take this twice a day and you should rest. If it does not improve, you have to go to the doctor.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.english: Thank you very much. Can I pay by card?

practice.title: Describe your symptoms
practice.instruction: Role-play a pharmacy or doctor’s visit. Say how you feel, name one or two symptoms with doler, and use deber, poder, or tener que at least once each.
tips: If it is a real emergency, keep one phrase whole.
Llame a una ambulancia. Say it exactly as it is.
